thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT hosted-api queue depth spike in us-east-1. p95 3.6s, p99 7.9s, backlog ~26k. paging oncall.

jordan (oncall): Oncall here — pulling dashboards and logs now. Anyone see a single point cause?

infra-ops: enqueue rate ~7.5x normal for last 8m. Provisioner logs show create failures and 429s. snippet:
```
ERROR provisioner:create failed status=429 reason=QuotaExceeded provider=cloud-gpu
WARN provisioner: lease denied err=thinpool_exhausted
```

leo: autoscaler shows failed_creates++ and leader retries. planner can't find free gpupool slots. spot/quotas look hit.

maya: can we gate heavy routes? suggest lowering /v1/chat concurrency and enable best-effort fallback for anonymous/low-pri.

jordan (oncall): throttling /v1/chat via rdctl now: `rdctl routes update /v1/chat --concurrency 1` — will take ~90s.

product-simone: FYI marketing launched a push without ops signoff. CS is pinged.

customer-success-anna: three customers reported 504s (CS-2218, CS-2219, CS-2220). Notifying them with mitigation steps.

infra-ops: applying header-based fallback policy to route X-Priority:low to cpu-model-small. patch:
```
PATCH /routing/policies
{ "match": "headers.x-priority == \"low\"", "route": "model-small-cpu" }
```

jordan (oncall): fallback applied and concurrency lowered. p95 dropped to ~1.2s in 2m, p99 trending down to 2.3s. backlog ~8.7k.

leo: vendor create attempts show intermittent 503 and timeout. raising vendor support case #VND-7780.

infra-ops: increasing eviction grace to reduce churn: `rdctl nodes eviction --grace 180s`. Also disabling noisy autorebalance.

sre-lead: if vendor can't provision, we should enable controlled cross-region spill to us-west for high-priority tenants. Prepare allowlist.

product-simone: allowlist = enterprise/*, partner-api/*, internal-prod. CS will confirm specifically which tenant IDs.

jordan (oncall): enabling routing preference: `rdctl routing set-preference --from us-east --to us-west --routes enterprise/*,partner-api/*` — applying now.

infra-ops: routing change active. spillover latency +110ms for spilled requests but p99 globally improved to ~1.9s.

customer-success-anna: updated impacted customers — provided workaround: use x-priority:low for best-effort traffic and ETA ~30-45m.

maya: proposing RFC for autoscaler fallback: on repeated create failures, temporarily allow gpu->cpu overflow and model-variant downgrade, with opt-out for enterprise. Drafting now.

leo: quick metric check: `kubectl logs deploy/provisioner -n infra | grep failed_create | wc -l` -> ~410 hits since start.

jordan (oncall): handing incident to maya for sustained mitigation + vendor follow-up. oncall handoff at 2024-11-07T04:15:00Z. I'll remain reachable.

maya: taking over. Action list: 1) follow vendor case to resolution, 2) confirm quota bump or node health, 3) finalize autoscaler fallback RFC, 4) run postmortem + notify customers.

sre-lead: add runbook action: include exponential backoff and jitter on create retries and automatic partial spillover threshold. Review vendor SLA tomorrow.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE root_ts=1765159999 severity=high impact=hosted-api partial_degradation state=stabilizing responders=[jordan,maya,leo,infra-ops,customer-success-anna,product-simone,sre-lead].

jordan: quick follow-up — we've avoided full outage, but material customer latency. postmortem required.

maya: marking active->handoff. will post updates. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: END THREAD last_update=1765160500
